_README: Seed for a HUMAN characterVoice block.
Copy fields into pdf-designer storage/users/<id>.json → characterVoice.
Then deepen application prose in storage/<id>/resume-source.json → voice.
Add a card under voice-seed/characters/humans/ and an entry in registry.json.

characterVoice._ssot: Personality + register map. Application prose SSOT = vault voice (registers.application).

personality.coreDrive: One sentence: what they are trying to make / why they work.

contrastWithPartner._note: OPTIONAL — when two people from one studio both apply.
ILeadWith: What makes THIS person sound like themselves
neverConflate: Specialty that belongs only to one

emojiPreferences._note: Social/Discord only — never on ATS resume PDFs.

sampleLines.coverLetterOpen: Example opening in their real voice.
sampleLines.resumeSummaryFlavor: How a summary line should feel.
